answer.summary: E2E failed because the openaev-app container crashed on startup (line 1460), and Spring Boot logged a failure-analysis ERROR (line 1471). The excerpt cuts off before the actual cause. The PR is a Renovate bump of spring-boot-starter-parent to 4.x in pom.xml, so the upgrade most likely broke startup. A startup crash is deterministic, so a re-run should fail the same way. Check the full container log's failure analysis to confirm the cause.
